    "e11f22b6: ;Execute the label X_DQ and kill YS.",

    "9a578c81: ;Write bell character and '??'. If DB(DQ) exists, go to Z^DIE17.",
    "afd9a53e: ;Set X to '?BAD'.",
    "6cf50f74: ;Set DZ to X, execute routines D and QQ^DIEQ, then go to label B.",
    "798be3c6: Set up variables for DIE call.",

    "362b8ee4: If existing text, set up variables from existing text.",
    "a61b01e7: If pointer to file entry, get .01 field.",
    "6b0b89e2: If value is found, process it.",
    "169d9ed5: If Set logic, resolve set logic.",
    "3725537f: If user entered data, re-display and update X. If DC is less than 2, delete data.",
    "254e424f: If not Input transform, branch.",
    "595b7501: Else, apply Input transform on data.",
    "065303b4: End of code.",
    "d7a2d897: Define variable names for labels and file fields.",
    "b0983c12: Identify fields and characteristics for the DATE REVIEWED field.",
    "7b7bd249: Jump to field replication.",
    "ecc88bf3: FOR DATE REVIEWED: Format date and perform date edits.",
    "8fbefdb9: End of date edits.",
    "29256cbf: ;If value exists for DATE REVIEWED, display form to edit it.",
    "e6a1ac45: ;If DATE REVIEWED is before DATE DICTATED, display error message and reset DATE REVIEWED.",
    "39fa1c77: ;Exit DATE REVIEWED input.",
    "0f936dfd: ;If value exists for SIGNED BY, display form to edit it.",

  ]
